IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillCarpentry_1: Can you teach me something about woodworking?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCarpentry_1: Always measure twice, cut once. And keep your tools sharp Ã¢â‚¬â€ a dull saw is dangerous and sloppy.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillCarpentry_2: What's the most useful thing you built?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCarpentry_2: Solid joints make solid structures. Learn to nail and screw properly and you can build almost anything.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillCarpentry_3: How do you reinforce a base out here?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCarpentry_3: Double up the walls, brace the corners, and always build on a proper foundation. Shortcuts get people killed.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillMechanics_1: How do you keep a vehicle running out here?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillMechanics_1: Check your fluids first Ã¢â‚¬â€ oil, coolant, brake fluid. If it runs, listen for what sounds wrong. Engines talk if you let them.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillMechanics_2: What's the easiest car repair to learn?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillMechanics_2: Tire changes and battery swaps. After that, belts and filters. Simple stuff keeps a car alive longer than anything.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillMechanics_3: How do I know if an engine is worth fixing?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillMechanics_3: Smoke, knocking, seized parts Ã¢â‚¬â€ those are signs it's gone. Otherwise, most things are fixable if you have time and parts.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillCooking_1: Any tips for cooking with limited supplies?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCooking_1: You'd be surprised what you can do with canned goods and a fire. Season everything, and never waste fat Ã¢â‚¬â€ it adds flavor and calories.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillCooking_2: How do you know if food is still safe to eat?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCooking_2: Smell it, look at it. If it smells off or has mold, toss it. When in doubt, cook it Ã¢â‚¬â€ heat kills most things.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillCooking_3: What's the easiest thing to cook without equipment?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCooking_3: Stews. One pot, water, and whatever you find. Boil it long enough and almost anything becomes edible.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillFarming_1: Do you know how to grow food?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFarming_1: Good soil, water, sunlight, and patience. Raised beds help Ã¢â‚¬â€ they drain better and keep pests away from the roots.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillFarming_2: What's the easiest thing to grow out here?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFarming_2: Potatoes and beans. They grow fast, don't need much, and give you calories. Tomatoes too, if you have seeds.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillFarming_3: How do you deal with pests on crops?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFarming_3: Rotate your crops and keep the area clean. Companion planting helps too Ã¢â‚¬â€ some plants keep bugs away from others naturally.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillFirstAid_1: Do you know how to treat wounds out here?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFirstAid_1: Clean it immediately, always. Pressure stops bleeding. Without antibiotics, infection is what actually kills you Ã¢â‚¬â€ watch for redness and fever.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillFirstAid_2: What's the most important thing in a first aid kit?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFirstAid_2: Antiseptic and bandages. Everything else is secondary. A clean wound that's wrapped properly heals. A dirty one doesn't.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillFirstAid_3: How do you treat a broken bone with nothing?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFirstAid_3: Splint it Ã¢â‚¬â€ any straight, rigid material works. Tie it in place, immobilize the joint, don't let them walk on it. And pray.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillElectrical_1: How do you get power going without the grid?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillElectrical_1: Generators are your best bet. Keep the fuel fresh, don't overload it, and run it away from where people sleep Ã¢â‚¬â€ carbon monoxide kills silently.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillElectrical_2: Any tips for dealing with electrical problems?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillElectrical_2: Never touch anything live. Always cut power first. Circuit breakers exist for a reason Ã¢â‚¬â€ if one trips repeatedly, something is wrong upstream.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillElectrical_3: How do you rewire something safely?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillElectrical_3: Match wire gauges, secure all connections, and insulate everything. Bad insulation causes fires. Fires out here are a death sentence.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillAiming_1: Can you give me any shooting tips?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillAiming_1: Control your breathing. Squeeze the trigger, don't pull it. And focus on the front sight Ã¢â‚¬â€ everything else blurs, and that's fine.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillAiming_2: How do you stay accurate when you're scared?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillAiming_2: Training. Muscle memory kicks in when your brain shuts down from fear. Dry fire every night if you can Ã¢â‚¬â€ repetition is everything.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Q_SkillAiming_3: What's the biggest mistake people make with guns?
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillAiming_3: Panicking and shooting fast. You'll miss and waste ammo. Slow down, aim, and make the shot count. Ammo is survival.
